# RestaurantAnswering

> RestaurantAnswering, for restaurants.

RestaurantAnswering is an AI answering service for restaurants that answers calls 24/7, takes phone orders, books reservations and manages waitlists without adding staff. It answers in under a second at 95% order accuracy and recovers $30k+ in annual revenue from missed and after-hours calls. Plans start at $29 for 100 minutes, with volume pricing as low as $0.08/min.

## Start here

- [Restaurant Answering: AI Phone Orders & Reservations 24/7](https://restaurantanswering.com/): RestaurantAnswering is an AI answering service for restaurants that answers every call 24/7, takes phone orders, books reservations and manages waitlists.

## Loman AI Alternative: Restaurant Phone Answering Compared
https://restaurantanswering.com/loman-ai/

Loman AI is a voice agent product aimed at restaurants, built around answering inbound calls and taking orders. In the material available to us, Loman does not publish its per-minute or per-location pricing, so we cannot state what it costs — it is not public. What is public is the category it competes in: AI phone answering for restaurants, the same job RestaurantAnswering does.

## Restaurant Answering: AI Phone Orders & Reservations 24/7
https://restaurantanswering.com/

A restaurant phone rings hardest exactly when nobody can pick it up. The line that goes unanswered at 7:40pm on a Friday is a takeout order that never gets placed, a reservation that never gets booked, and a caller who dials the next restaurant on the list. RestaurantAnswering is an AI answering service for restaurants that answers every call 24/7, takes phone orders, books reservations and manages waitlists without adding staff. It is not a phone tree and it is not a voicemail box. It is a voice agent that talks to the caller, works from your live menu and availability, and writes the result into the systems your team already uses.

## Restaurants Pricing: What an AI Answering Service Costs
https://restaurantanswering.com/pricing-for-restaurants/

You are billed by talk time, not by call count. A monthly plan includes a block of minutes, and every call the AI handles — a to-go order, a reservation, a waitlist check, a question about hours — draws down that block. Plans start at $29/month for 100 included minutes, and the published rate falls as low as $0.08/min at volume. There is no per-seat charge, because the AI answers every call 24/7 rather than routing callers into a queue.
